scope: Coefficients for 20 imputation-specific fusion logistic models
recommended_interface: JSON coefficients and the documented sigmoid equation

input_contract.requirement: Supply the already encoded, imputed, and normalized 12 clinical inputs used by the study pipeline plus the aligned paper image-model score.

equation: p_m = sigmoid(intercept_m + sum_j coefficient_mj * x_j); final p = mean_m(p_m)
